query:
SELECT a.id, a.startTime, a.endTime, a.therapyType, a.status, p.name as patientName
FROM appointments a
LEFT JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
WHERE a.therapistUserId = 4620148
AND a.startTime >= '2026-06-17 00:00:00'
AND a.startTime < '2026-06-18 00:00:00'
AND a.status != 'rescheduled'
ORDER BY a.startTime;
